purpose: The governed vocabulary for this wiki's tags, in the SKOS data model: one preferred label per concept, variants resolve as altLabels and never fork, every concept carries a definition and a scopeNote saying what the tag means HERE. Maintained with scripts/wiki_tags.py.
maintenance: New tags are registered at first use (wiki_tags.py register) — a tag that reaches a page before the registry is exactly what `wiki_tags.py check` surfaces. Deprecation is by the tool's deprecate command: status flips, a replacedBy pointer is recorded, the concept is never deleted (supersede, don't delete). Pages are never rewritten by the tooling; check reports, humans and the owner rule. The usage block on each concept is a seed-time snapshot; check and resolve always recompute live usage from the corpus.
judgement_calls: Seeded 2026-10-28 under the owner's fix-all directive: this tree carried the tags tooling from the marathon builds but no registry, so all 47 tags in use read as unregistered. Seeded from the live census (46 pages, 96 uses) with first-draft glosses written from each tag's corpus uses, correctable on the record like anything else in the wiki.
Location: evaluation/tag-registry.jsonl, with the wiki's other governed registers — not a wiki page. A page would be a second, hand-maintained copy of state the tooling reads.
Hierarchy starts flat at the seed except where the corpus makes it unambiguous; relations grow by registration.
